title: Canonical schema/prompt example project
goal: Add a small but real example that demonstrates StateSpec's schema-driven loop: one schema validates data and generates prompt material, so docs/prompts/examples cannot drift from the schema.
acceptance_criteria: invalid_slice.json fails schema validation with a useful error
generate_prompt.py creates a deterministic prompt from the schema
test_schema_prompt_loop.py fails if generated_prompt.md drifts from the schema
non_goals: Replace the full StateSpec schema validator
Make the example a runtime dependency of StateSpec
known_limits: The example is intentionally small and educational.
The generated prompt uses only schema field names and descriptions.
